race.comment: FEDERAL SABLE (1) was strongly fancied last time but ran below expectations when fourth (17.19), beaten 6 lengths. Remains without a win from the draw but has been in the placings two times from three attempts. Has ability and can bounce back. SQUIRREL THIEF (8) showed little early speed at his last couple, the latest finishing seventh (31.55) in a Maiden at Q Parklands. Worth following up. BYE BRUNETTE (2) turned in a moderate run last time when sixth at this track over 300m behind Classy Blue (17.27). Should be about the money. MOOSE (3) is in the mix despite missing out at this track last time.
